sources.summary: Small technical/product prototype, not a production CRM replacement.

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/Base UI, selected AI Elements, AI SDK, Zod, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, Vitest and Playwright are the planned stack; Vercel is a deployment target, not deployment authorization.
Use a real DeepSeek model and real tool execution; seed business data may be synthetic.
sources.origin_ref: User real-LLM and server-env decisions; docs/product-scope.md#success-criteria

sources.summary: Keep model key server-only and model ID configurable.
Customer, Deal, Activity and Task are the initial deterministic persistent records.
Explore exposes customers, deals, activities, tasks and a simple pipeline/table representation without full CRUD parity.
Today, Workspace and Explore form a stable shell; Today shows deterministic totals, agent situations and actual activity.
Approved read tools are get_crm_summary, list_deals, get_deal, get_account_context and get_recent_activities.
Only Focus, Investigation and Comparison workspaces, using a discriminated schema and direct renderer mapping.
Approved primitives are SituationCard, EvidenceList, Timeline, DataTable and ActionCard; one shared design system owns visuals.
Facts, evidence, scope, timestamps and action outcomes are traceable; uncertainty is labelled without invented confidence scores.
Exactly one mutation: create_task OR update_deal_stage; propose, approve, execute, verify persistence. Choice remains open.
Loading, empty, failure, unavailable, success, long-content and narrow-screen states must remain understandable.
Keyboard, focus, labels, semantics, contrast, target sizes and non-color meaning are required accessibility considerations.
Demonstrate focus -> investigate ACME -> approve one action -> inspect persistent result; validate with Vitest, Playwright and real-model evidence.
Work phase by phase; the roadmap is sequencing, not permission to execute.
Adopt Agent Continuity v0.3.4: sources/checks/evidence, honest gates, reconciliation and review findings, without building a separate continuity product.
sources.origin_ref: User continuity acknowledgement; Agent Continuity v0.3.4
